claims.claim: RuPay is owned and operated by NPCI and was launched in 2012 to fulfil RBI's vision of a domestic open multilateral card system.
claims.quote: conceived and owned by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI). It was launched in 2012, to fulfil the Reserve Bank of India 's (RBI) vision
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Page last edited 5 September 2026. No ownership change since 2020; NPCI remains the owner. NPCI's own pages returned 403 to curl and a JS shell to WebFetch.

claims.claim: NPCI is an RBI/IBA initiative under the PSS Act 2007, founded December 2008, registered under Section 8 of the Companies Act, headquartered in Mumbai.
claims.quote: an initiative of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and the Indian Banks' Association (IBA) under the provisions of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007
claims.title: National Payments Corporation of India - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Same page: 'Founded in December 2008, the NPCI is a government organisation registered under Section 8 of the Companies Act 2013'; category 'Financial services companies based in Mumbai'.

claims.claim: NPCI shareholding was broadened in 2016 from ten promoter banks to a wider set of public, private, foreign, co-operative and regional rural banks.
claims.quote: In 2016, the shareholding was diluted to include 13 additional public sector banks, 15 additional private sector banks, 1 additional foreign bank, 10 multi-state co-operative banks
claims.title: National Payments Corporation of India - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Ten promoter banks named: SBI, PNB, Canara, BoB, Union Bank, BoI, ICICI, HDFC, Citibank, HSBC.

claims.claim: NPCI International Payments Limited (NIPL), the subsidiary that takes RuPay and UPI abroad, was launched on 19 August 2020.
claims.quote: NPCI launched a subsidiary called NPCI International Payments Limited (NIPL) on 19 August 2020 to increase the globalisation and availability of RuPay in foreign markets.
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: nipl.net.in could not be fetched (TLS certificate mismatch).

claims.claim: As of November 2020 around 753 million RuPay cards had been issued by nearly 1,158 banks (participant count proxy).
claims.quote: As of November 2020, around 753 million RuPay cards have been issued by nearly 1,158 banks.
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Figure conflicts with another passage on the same page (603.6 million / 'more than 60 crore' as of November 2020); see contradictions. No newer public card count could be fetched; NPCI statistics page blocked.

claims.claim: RuPay's domestic market share was 34% of card transactions by volume and 30% by value as of March 2021.
claims.quote: As of March 2021, the market share of RuPay in India was at 34% by volume of transactions and at 30% by value
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Cites Financial Express interview, 23 March 2021.

claims.claim: RuPay's international alliance with Discover (now Capital One-owned) dates from 7 March 2012 and gives RuPay Global cards acceptance on Discover, Diners Club and PULSE.
claims.quote: On 7 March 2012, NPCI entered into a strategic partnership with Discover Financial for RuPay, enabling RuPay Global Cards to utilise Discover Card , Diners Club Inter
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Predates Capital One's 18 May 2025 acquisition of Discover. Page also lists partner networks: JCB, UnionPay (China), BC Card (South Korea), Pulse (US), Diners Club International, Elo.

claims.claim: Discover Global Network lists RuPay among its 30+ network alliances and describes it as a national network with merchants and ATMs across India.
claims.quote: RuPay, supported by the Central Bank of India, is a national payment network with merchants and ATMs across India.
claims.title: Reach and Acceptance | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Page footer © 2026 DFS Services LLC, i.e. post-Capital One acquisition. Same page: 'Discover® Network has 30+ network alliances' and 'accepted in more than 185 countries and territories'. No RuPay-specific counts given.

claims.claim: The RuPay-JCB Global co-branded card was launched on 22 July 2019 after JCB acceptance on Indian POS and ATMs was enabled in 2017.
claims.quote: NPCI, with JCB launched the RuPay-JCB Global card on 22 July 2019.
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported

claims.claim: RuPay card services were formally launched in Mauritius on 12 February 2024, allowing Mauritian banks to issue RuPay cards.
claims.quote: On 12 February 2024, India officially launched RuPay card services in Mauritius.
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Same page: 'allowing Mauritian banks to issue cards utilizing the RuPay mechanism there'.

claims.claim: Merchant discount rate on RuPay debit card transactions was set to zero from 1 January 2020 (a government mandate), removing merchant-side interchange for that product.
claims.quote: All merchant discount rate (MDR) charges were eliminated for transactions done using Rupay debit cards from 1 January 2020.
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Zero-MDR on RuPay debit and BHIM-UPI is a Government of India policy; the underlying notification (Income Tax Dept Notification No.105/2019, 30 Dec 2019) is cited on the page but was not fetched.

claims.claim: Historically NPCI charged a flat per-transaction switching fee of 60 paise to the acquirer and 30 paise to the issuer on RuPay.
claims.quote: The NPCI charged a flat-fee per transaction of 60 paise from acquiring bank and 30 paise from the card issuing bank.
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Undated historical figure ('initially'); current switching fees not publicly fetched. Page also states processing fees were 'approximately 23% lower than those charged by Visa and Mastercard'.

claims.claim: NPCI publishes an interchange and pricing circular for RuPay acceptance in Singapore, UAE and South Korea, but the PDF sits on npci.org.in, which blocks fetching.
claims.quote: Interchange and Pricing circular for Acceptance of RuPay cards in Singapore, United Arab Emirates & South Korea
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Citation title only, as listed on Wikipedia (reference retrieved 8 April 2020). Content not read; no domestic interchange schedule could be fetched.

claims.claim: Indian businesses with annual turnover above ₹50 crore are mandated to offer RuPay debit and UPI as payment options.
claims.quote: All Indian companies with an annual turnover exceeding ₹ 50 crore (US$5.2 million) are required to offer RuPay debit card and Unified Payments Interface as a payment option
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Section 269SU Income-tax Act mandate, effective 1 January 2020. NPCI rulebook and circulars pages were blocked; no public RuPay operating rules edition could be confirmed.

claims.claim: Issuers can link RuPay credit cards to UPI (Credit on UPI), permitted by RBI from 8 June 2022 and launched 20 September 2022.
claims.quote: From 8 June 2022, RBI allowed the linking of RuPay credit cards with India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI).
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Same page: 'The service was officially launched on 20 September 2022'; RuPay credit usage crossed ₹10,000 crore in a month in December 2023.

claims.claim: NPCI offers network tokenisation for RuPay via the Token Reference On File (TROF) service launched 21 October 2021, backed by the RuPay Network Secure Vault.
claims.quote: NPCI on 21 October 2021 launched Token Reference On File (TROF) service that will help keep RuPay card details into RuPay Network Secure Vault.
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Value-added network service for issuers, merchants and acquirers.

claims.claim: RuPay PaySecure is the network's e-commerce authentication service for card-not-present payments, launched 21 June 2013.
claims.quote: On 21 June 2013, NPCI launched RuPay PaySecure that enabled card holders make online payment .
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported

claims.claim: RuPay On-the-Go is an open-loop contactless wearable form factor launched at Global Fintech Festival 2021 for issuers and device partners.
claims.quote: NPCI on the eve of Global Fintech Festival 2021 launched RuPay On-the-Go interoperable, open-loop contactless solution that are made available on smartwatch
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Launched with YES Bank (BusinessLine, 28 Sep 2021).

claims.claim: 1 August 2024: RBL Bank launched RuPay credit cards integrating NCMC transit and UPI functionality.
claims.quote: On 1 August 2024, RBL Bank announced integration of National Common Mobility Card and UPI capabilities with RuPay credit cards.
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Cites Business Standard, 1 Aug 2024.

claims.claim: August 2024 (Global Fintech Fest 2024): Airtel Payments Bank, Noise and NPCI launched a smartwatch with an embedded RuPay chip supporting NCMC.
claims.quote: At the Global Fintech Fest 2024 , Airtel Payments Bank , in collaboration with Noise and the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), launched a smartwatch
claims.title: RuPay - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Cites HT Tech, 29 Aug 2024.

claims.claim: 11 September 2026: NPCI reported FY26 net profit down 12% to ₹1,362 crore on revenue up 21% to ₹4,000 crore (as cited by Wikipedia from a journalist's post).
claims.quote: NPCI FY26 net profit declines 12% to Rs 1,362 crore, revenue up 21% at Rs 4,000 crore
claims.title: National Payments Corporation of India - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Citation title only; source is a Moneycontrol journalist's X post dated 11 September 2026, not fetched. Treat as unconfirmed.

claims.claim: Leadership: Dilip Asbe was reappointed NPCI MD & CEO for five years in September 2022; Ajay Kumar Choudhary is listed as non-executive chairman.
claims.quote: NPCI reappoints Dilip Asbe as MD and CEO for 5 years
claims.title: National Payments Corporation of India - Wikipedia
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Citation title (Hindu BusinessLine, 23 Sep 2022). Infobox lists 'Ajay Kumar Choudhary (Non-Exe Chairman)' and 'Dilip Asbe (MD & CEO)'.
